desc_en: Ti-dominant: pursues internal consistency of concepts and loves breaking problems down to first principles. Ne-auxiliary branches out new possibilities — the classic “thinks deep, branches wide” thinker who values precise expression.
desc_zh: Ti 主导：追求概念的内在一致性，喜欢拆解问题到最底层原理。Ne 辅助发散新可能，是典型"想得深、发散广"的思考者，重视精确表达。
